f. Read and observe underlined words.
Gadge Maharaj was a saint in Maharashtra. His name was Debuji. He
lived a simple life. He taught people to be kind.

For the Teacher :
- Encourage learners to collect information of different saints from Maharashtra.
Encourage them to read books about saints.
Encourage them to talk about the key elements/events, ideas from this lesson.
